CustomField.description: Sticky lock: set by the fixture sync once the deadline has passed and never cleared (validation rule Locked_Stays_Locked). Protects against the deadline moving later after a last-minute postponement. Predictions are locked when Locked__c is true OR the deadline has passed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Once locked, predictions for this gameweek can't be changed, even if a match is postponed afterwards.
CustomField.label: Locked
